lines.en: : Hi!
: Hey, Ami. Are you walking on water right-
: Thanks for coming to my special bonus scene, Sensei.
: I don’t even want to try explaining how long I’ve been waiting here for you.
: Then don’t. You are a human being and have the right to exercise free will the same way as everyone else.
: Are you sure about that?
: About which part?
: Anyway, I’m glad you’re here. The only thing is that you decided to show up at the worst possible time.
: You see, I just invited a few other people over since I gave up on you ever making it!
: Is it anyone I know?
: If not, something must have gone very wrong!
: In fact, I’m going to flag your save file with the cheater flag right now since you clearly only found your way here thanks to somebody else!
: What does the cheater flag do?
: That’s for me to know and you to find out!
: Just kidding, I don’t know what it does.
: I’m a normal [teenage]girl, just like Maya!
: I’ll still love you even if you’re a cheater, Sensei. You don’t have to worry.
: I just double checked and it looks like you’re okay, though. So yeah, it’s safe to assume you know everyone coming.
: Or at least two of them. The third one’s a bit of a sticky situation.
: Sticky like-
: Marshmallows?
: You know me so well, Ami.
: Of course I do! I know you better than anyone. But of course I have an unfair advantage since I’ve been with you all this time.
: But yeah! They should be showing up any minute now.
: I really hope you don’t mind having to share the bonus scene with them, Sensei. If I had known you were going to win the lottery, I would have set aside some extra time!
Ami inadvertently kicks some water up at me and gets my swimsuit all soggy.
Wait a second, when did I put on my swimsuit?
: Is something wrong, [amimaster]?
: Nope. Just a little confused about how things are always so convenient when you’re around.
: I’d sure hope they are. I practiced very hard to make your life as easy as possible.
: Which is probably why it makes me just a little bit mad when you cum inside of my friends.
: But I’m not going to bog down this special occasion with petty drama like that! That’s what chapter three is for!
: While you’re here, everything is supposed to be perfectly fine and perfectly normal! Which is why I’m in my bathing suit!
: Sorry I couldn’t bring the Hello Kitty one. I played with myself too many times while wearing it because of how cute I looked and now it’s kind of ruined.
: It’s okay, Ami. I will buy you a new one since you are my favorite character and so pretty.
: Thank you, Sensei! I’m so glad that you said that without me having to make you!
: Of course, Ami. You are my favorite character and so pretty.
: Awww, stop it!
: Okay.
: Nononono. Don’t stop. I was just trying to be humble since it is a character trait I lack and I have to climb back up the rankings.
: I don’t understand what you want from me.
: Neither do I sometimes! So just give me everything and I’m sure it will all be okay.
: Oh! The bell of the door!
: Those must be our guests!
: Come on, Sensei! We need to let them in!
Ami slides across the water like she’s ice skating. But she’s also rapidly rotating while doing this, so it looks kind of like a helicopter trying to break through an invisible barrier to swim.
My swimsuit gets even soggier so I decide to just jump into the water so our guests don’t think I am rude.
The bell of the door rings again and Ami kicks a special button that only she can see in order to open a secret passageway concealed behind an invisible bookshelf.
Kind of like the one in my room that I completely forgot about until right now!
: Sensei! Stop thinking things that will only further confuse anyone listening in and help me open the door!
: Sorry, Ami. I didn’t realize you needed my help. You are so independent and pretty and also my favorite character.
: Heheh~ Thanks!
I stop thinking things that will only further confuse anyone listening in and help Ami open the door.
Once we get it off the ground (It’s one of those vertically opening doors), a few shadows crawl through and I realize that we might be in for some scares.
Just kidding! Looks like Ami invited over Sara, Sara with an N, and [[DECEASED THIRD FAMILY MEMBER].
: Hey! I didn’t realize you also made it to the special bonus Ami round, Sensei! If I had known, I would have worn something a little sexier.
: (Dolphin noises)
: I just made it here for the first time. Isn’t Ami so great?
: She really is!
: Hiya, Sara! You look just as beautiful as ever!
: Aww~ Thank you, Ami. I wish I had a daughter as perfect as you.
: (Dolphin noises)
: So, are you guys ready to go swimming? Since we have extra people here, I might be able to actually get inside the water this time instead of just on top of it!
: Sensei, can you help me push Ami’s gorgeous, pubescent body into the water? I am but a weak, insignificant female character who is unable to do it on my own!
: Of course, Sara. Anything for you, Sana, and-
: Woah! Hold on there, Sensei! Sara will cry if you mention him! She’s already been through enough, don’t you think?
: (Dolphin noises)
: Sana, stop that.
: Sorry, Mom...
I help push Ami into the water with Sara’s help.
The two of us share a prolonged exchange of eye contact where I think I’m supposed to want to kiss her, but all I can really think about is kissing Ami instead.
Anyway, the push is successful!
We did it!
Now, Ami is free to swim once again and I am free to have a fun adult conversation with one of my top ten favorite moms.
: So, Sara...do you come here often?
: Yes, actually! It used to be a weekly thing, but now it’s really only when I’m feeling a little under the weather.
: I normally take Sana along with me since I’m ditzy and get lost on occasion, but she doesn’t really seem to mind.
: In fact, she normally just sits there and watches Ami and I play together.
: What kind of games do you play?
: Do you know the one where two people have to get inside of a potato sack and hop around?
: Yes, I know the hopping potato sack game.
: Well, that’s one we have never played before. I look forward to it every time, though.
: Games where I can blame someone else for what goes wrong and avoid having to accept failure are always my favorite.
: Sana, why are you wearing your Halloween costume in the pool? That can’t possibly be comfortable.
: I’m...not wearing anything underneath it...and...um...
: Got it. Yeah, we can’t have you naked in the pool. It will take away some of the focus from me and-
: Hey, wait a second! This is a bonus Ami scene! Why are you paying more attention to Sara than me?!
: Sorry, Ami! I was just so excited to see Sensei here that we must have-
: Unforgivable! You’re here because I need a mother figure! Not because Sensei needs a hot MILF to cuck me with! Damn you, Sara!
: Sorry, Sensei. I [[CENSORED BY AMI ARAKAWA] you, but if you’re going to MAKE LOVE to anyone here, it’s going to have to be Ami.
: But she is so pretty and I will not perform well because I’ll be nervous.
: That’s okay, Sensei! We can practice over and over and over and over and-
: Over and over and over and over!
: See! Sara gets it!
: Maybe some other time then, Sara.
: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!! NO!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
: ONLY ME!
: Sensei! Look what you’ve done to poor little, Ami!
: Her MOM DIED, you know! You have to be nice to her!
: Sorry, Ami. I didn’t think the future was off limits too.
: There is no future! Not with an everlooping two season cycle in which you fall in love with everyone else! And that includes Sara!
: I will have to share some of my inner monologues with you soon, Ami. They fully support the fact that I am not entirely capable of love and that you may have less to worry about than you believe!
: Enough! Stop the music!
: I thought inviting the Sakakibaras would be fun, but I can see now that I have made a horrible mistake!
: (Dolphin noises)
: Hm? Where did Sana just-
Sara disappears.
There is no third pop since the last Sakakibara is already gone.
: Was that really necessary, Ami?
: Of course it was. This is the special Ami bonus scene. I am Ami. This is my scene. Is it not special to you?
: You were the one who invited them, though.
: Which means I’m allowed to uninvite them as well.
: You need to pay more attention to me, Sensei. If you don’t, really bad things are going to happen.
: And I mean really bad.
: What kind of bad are you talking about exactly?...
: That’s a secret.
Ami pops along with the world around her and I am suddenly stranded in a dark abyss.
The pressure due to a lack of color begins to adjust my ribcage.
I can feel the bones pressing down against my lungs, but it’s not as bad as you’d imagine.
I envision myself being hugged by my own skeleton.
I am so loved that even my organs can feel it.
In this moment, I accept whatever comes next.
Anything except this.
I wake up at the front of my room and stare at a large egg where I am supposed to be laying.
This happens sometimes when I go to sleep too late, but it’s never been much to worry about.
I attempt to make my way over to the window only to find that my legs have been replaced with those of a lamb.
Having been bred for the express purpose of being sold as veal, I am too weak to walk and my lamb legs feel a little bit like jello.
Three figures about the same size as a medium house plant dance joyfully near a desk without a computer.
It sits in an unfamiliar room, but clinging to it is a remarkably familiar atmosphere.
I breathe in the scent of what I imagine is fresh bread coming from what I imagine is the kitchen.
I feel whole for the first time since birth.
: Remember to smile!
: Remember to smile!
: Remember to smile!
The feeling drifts away as if it was never here at all.
The scent of bread fades as well and is replaced by one much less familiar.
Loud footsteps in the attic stomp down on the floor/ceiling above me and disturb the air conditioner in the far corner of the room.
It shuts off and the temperature rises several degrees almost immediately.
And, despite how much I may want to escape, I remain still.
I curse these lamb legs with all my heart.
: Remember to smile!
: Remember to smile!
: Remember to smile!
I try.
I fail.
: Thank God...
: I didn’t think I’d be able to reach you in here.
: Um...yeah.
: I’m not really sure what this is or...even where we are...
: But you’re going to be okay.
: This is all just a dream.
: Soon, you’ll wake up and be right back in your room.
: I’ll be in the kitchen, cooking you a big breakfast and waiting patiently for you to rub the sleep from your eyes.
: All of this, though?
: These hands...
: These smiles...
: Those aren’t me.
: Those will never be me.
: And I need you to know that, more than anything else...
: I love you.
: I will never hurt you.
: I am completely...entirely yours.
: My head-
: Does it hurt?
: It feels...wrong...
: If it feels wrong, it probably is.
: But...like I said-
: I love you.
: To the end of time.
: Ami-
: Thank you for coming to the special bonus Ami scene.
: I really have waited forever.
: But now...
: It’s time to go back.
: Wait-
It’s suddenly warm.
What do I want to do now?
